description: Detectable financial crime typologies mapped to available tables and columns. Each typology contributes to the TYPOLOGY_STRENGTH factor (weight 20) of the Exposure score in the SightLine dual-axis triage framework.
scoring_note: typology_points are additive but capped at 100 before the 0.20 factor weight is applied. All detection is deterministic and rule-based (light governance path). No LLM participates in scoring.

typologies.name: Structuring / Smurfing
typologies.logic: Count transactions per originator within TIME_WINDOW_HOURS where AMOUNT_ORIGINAL falls between (threshold * band_floor) and threshold, matched on currency.
typologies.critical_note: Must be computed on AMOUNT_ORIGINAL, not AMOUNT_USD. FX conversion destroys the just-under-threshold signal.
typologies.narrative_template: {count} transfers of {currency} {min_amt}-{max_amt} against a {currency} {threshold} reporting threshold within {window_hours} hours.

typologies.name: Velocity Spike
typologies.logic: z = (AMOUNT_USD - AVG_AMOUNT_USD) / STDDEV_AMOUNT_USD for the entity's own baseline period. Also flag daily count exceeding MAX_DAILY_COUNT.
typologies.critical_note: Guard against STDDEV_AMOUNT_USD null or zero. TRANSACTION_BASELINES has multiple BASELINE_PERIOD rows per company - select one explicitly.
typologies.narrative_template: Transaction of USD {amount} is {z} standard deviations above this entity's {period} baseline average of USD {baseline_avg}.

typologies.name: Pass-through / Funnel Account
typologies.logic: Self-join: company receives as beneficiary then sends as originator within dwell_days, with outbound total >= inflow_retention_pct of inbound total.
typologies.narrative_template: Entity received USD {inbound} and disbursed USD {outbound} within {dwell_days} days, retaining {retained_pct}% - consistent with pass-through behaviour.

typologies.name: Round-tripping / Circular Flow
typologies.logic: Recursive self-join detecting cycles A->B->C->A within cycle_window_days where final amount is within amount_tolerance_pct of the original.
typologies.critical_note: Test cheaply with a 2-hop join on a 6-month subset before committing build time. If the synthetic generator did not plant cycles, this returns nothing.
typologies.narrative_template: Funds traced through {hop_count} entities returning to origin within {days} days, {tolerance_pct}% amount variance.

typologies.name: Shell Company Layering
typologies.logic: Substance test: low EMPLOYEE_COUNT relative to high ANNUAL_REVENUE_USD, plus incorporation country differing from headquarters country, plus recent incorporation.
typologies.narrative_template: Counterparty reports USD {revenue} annual revenue with {employees} employees, incorporated in {inc_country} but headquartered in {hq_country}.

typologies.name: Nominee / Shared-Owner Network
typologies.logic: Normalise OWNER_NAME (upper, strip punctuation, collapse whitespace), group, count distinct COMPANY_ID. Flag owners spanning multiple otherwise unrelated companies.
typologies.critical_note: No owner ID exists in the schema - name normalisation is required and fuzzy matching is the only linkage available.
typologies.narrative_template: {owner_name} appears as beneficial owner across {company_count} companies including {examples}.

typologies.name: Ownership Opacity
typologies.logic: GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, flag where SUM(OWNERSHIP_PERCENTAGE) < 100 (unexplained ownership) or VERIFIED_DATE is null/stale.
typologies.critical_note: SUM > 100 is a data error, not a signal - exclude from this factor but retain the row.
typologies.narrative_template: Declared beneficial ownership totals {declared_pct}%, leaving {gap_pct}% unaccounted for.

typologies.name: Corruption / PEP Proceeds
typologies.logic: PEP present in the ownership chain combined with a residence or transaction jurisdiction above the corruption index threshold.
typologies.narrative_template: Beneficial owner {owner_name} is a politically exposed person ({position}) resident in {country}, corruption index {index}.

typologies.name: Sanctions Evasion via Alias
typologies.logic: Fuzzy match BENEFICIARY_NAME against both ENTITY_NAME and the parsed ALIASES field, filtered to active listings valid at transaction date.
typologies.critical_note: Most teams will match ENTITY_NAME only. The ALIASES field is where the differentiated hit comes from.
typologies.narrative_template: Beneficiary '{beneficiary_name}' matches sanctioned alias '{alias}' of {entity_name} ({list_source}, {program}) at {score}% similarity.

typologies.name: Jurisdiction Hopping / U-turn
typologies.logic: Flag divergence between destination country, beneficiary country, and the country implied by BIC positions 5-6. Benign endpoints with a high-risk route.
typologies.narrative_template: Payment routed to {destination} but beneficiary registered in {beneficiary_country} with settlement bank in {bic_country}.

typologies.name: High-risk Corridor Exposure
typologies.logic: Map originating, destination and beneficiary country IDs to COUNTRIES risk attributes; take the maximum risk across all legs.
typologies.narrative_template: Transaction involves {country}, currently {fatf_status} on the FATF list, corruption index {index}.

typologies.name: New-counterparty Flooding
typologies.logic: Flag entities whose NEW_COUNTERPARTY_PCT in the current period materially exceeds their prior period value.
typologies.narrative_template: {new_pct}% of counterparties this period were previously unseen, against a prior-period rate of {prior_pct}%.

typologies.name: Dormant Account Reactivation
typologies.logic: Long-standing relationship with near-zero baseline activity followed by a sudden material transaction.
typologies.narrative_template: Entity onboarded {relationship_years} years ago recorded {baseline_count} transactions in the prior {months} months before this USD {amount} transfer.

excluded_typologies.name: Trade-based money laundering
excluded_typologies.reason: partial - no invoice or shipping data; only implausibility inference via PAYMENT_PURPOSE vs INDUSTRIES

excluded_typologies.name: Mirror trading
excluded_typologies.reason: partial - no securities leg in schema

excluded_typologies.name: Correspondent / nested banking
excluded_typologies.reason: partial - BENEFICIARY_BANK_BIC only, no bank reference table

excluded_typologies.name: Insider / internal fraud
excluded_typologies.reason: deliberately out of scope - AUDIT_LOG user-level analysis triggers German Works Council consultation (4-6 months)

excluded_typologies.name: Cash structuring
excluded_typologies.reason: no cash or branch data - institutional payments only

governance.validation_path: light - rule-based prioritisation per TrustSphere Model Risk Management policy
governance.llm_role: narrative generation only, grounded strictly in computed factor values and retrieved row data
governance.prohibited: no autonomous payment or account blocking; human accountable for all SAR decisions
